2608.00442.title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
2608.00442.paper_summary: Medical anomaly detection identifies abnormal images and localizes lesions under scarce supervision while generalizing across organs and modalities. Existing CLIP-based methods reduce annotation requirements through vision--language alignment, but their normal and abnormal references, whether text prompts or learned visual tokens, remain fixed across test images. Such static references may not transfer reliably to unseen targets in a cross-domain medical imaging scenario. To address this, we propose ReCAP, a language-free framework that replaces static anchors with input-conditioned visual prototypes. ReCAP re-centers separated normal and abnormal prototypes for each image through a bounded gated modulation, enabling query-adaptive anomaly scoring while constraining context-induced prototype drift. For the few-shot setting, we introduce a non-parametric normal-reference memory to preserve instance-level target-domain variation and complement the conditional prototype branch. Across six medical benchmarks, ReCAP achieves the best image-level AUROC on all zero-shot and 23 of 24 few-shot settings, and the best zero-shot pixel-level AUROC on all three segmentation datasets. Particularly, it reduces inference latency by over 70% compared to the fastest baseline, without text prompts or test-time gradient updates.
2608.00442.paper_summary_zh: 醫療異常檢測在稀少的監督下識別異常影像並定位病變，同時在不同的器官和模態之間進行泛化。現有的基於CLIP的方法通過視覺-語言對齊來減少標註需求，但它們的正常和異常參考，無論是文本提示還是學習到的視覺標記，在測試影像中仍然保持固定。這種靜態參考在跨領域醫學影像場景中可能無法可靠地轉移到未見的目標。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了ReCAP，一個無語言框架，將靜態錨點替換為輸入條件的視覺原型。ReCAP通過有界閘調制重新中心化每個影像的正常和異常原型，使查詢自適應的異常評分成為可能，同時限制上下文引起的原型漂移。對於少量樣本設置，我們引入了一種非參數的正常參考記憶，以保留實例級目標領域變異並補充條件原型分支。在六個醫療基準測試中，ReCAP在所有零樣本和24個少量樣本設置中的23個上達到了最佳影像級AUROC，並在所有三個分割數據集上達到了最佳零樣本像素級AUROC。特別是，與最快的基線相比，它將推斷延遲減少了超過70%，而不需要文本提示或測試時的梯度更新。
2608.00442.author: Yibo Wan et.al.
